parent_authority.meaning: E6 realizes arbitrary signed 3-CNF exactly; E7 seals that a universal polynomial exact carrier for that class exists iff P=NP. This artifact attacks the DIRECT_PVNP branch only.

direct_problem.input: arbitrary finite 3-CNF F on n Boolean variables
direct_problem.required_output: SAT with a reconstructable satisfying assignment, or UNSAT
direct_problem.firewall: No unit-cost exponential-bit integers, no hidden SAT oracle, no finite-corpus promotion, no bounded-width assumption, no unproved compression lemma.

boolean_quotient_formulation.clause_indicator: For C=(l1 OR l2 OR l3), c_C = 1-(1-l1)(1-l2)(1-l3) in B_n.
boolean_quotient_formulation.formula_indicator: p_F = product over clauses C of c_C in B_n.
boolean_quotient_formulation.exact_equivalence: F is satisfiable iff p_F is nonzero in B_n.

proved_barrier_inside_this_artifact.name: EXACT_MULTIPLICATIVE_BOOLEAN_QUOTIENT_SKETCH_REQUIRES_EXPONENTIAL_DIMENSION_V0_1
proved_barrier_inside_this_artifact.statement: Let A be a K-algebra and rho:B_n->A a K-algebra homomorphism. Suppose rho(p) != 0 for every nonzero singleton-assignment indicator p that is expressible as a 3-CNF indicator using duplicated unit literals. Then dim_K(A) >= 2^n. Consequently no polynomial-dimensional exact multiplicative algebra sketch can preserve nonzeroness even on this 3-CNF subfamily.
proof: For each Boolean assignment a in {0,1}^n define e_a = product_i x_i when a_i=1 and (1-x_i) when a_i=0.
Each e_a is a nonzero idempotent in B_n and is exactly the indicator of the singleton assignment a.
Each e_a can be realized by a 3-CNF using clauses (x_i OR x_i OR x_i) or (NOT x_i OR NOT x_i OR NOT x_i), so the assumed nonzero-preservation applies to all e_a.
For distinct a,b, e_a e_b = 0. Therefore rho(e_a)rho(e_b)=0, while each rho(e_a) is nonzero.
The family {rho(e_a)} is linearly independent: if sum_a alpha_a rho(e_a)=0, multiply by rho(e_b); all cross terms vanish and alpha_b rho(e_b)=0, hence alpha_b=0.
There are 2^n such elements, so dim_K(A) >= 2^n.
proved_barrier_inside_this_artifact.scope: Rules out exact polynomial-dimensional compression that is an algebra homomorphism preserving multiplication and singleton nonzeroness. It does not rule out non-homomorphic algorithms, adaptive elimination, cancellation methods, randomized algorithms, or P=NP.

discard: random evaluation sketches treated as exact multiplicative carriers
commuting-matrix homomorphic sketches of polynomial matrix dimension
fixed polynomial-dimensional quotient algebras claimed to preserve exact SAT nonzeroness
surviving_design_space: adaptive elimination whose intermediate representation is not a fixed multiplicative quotient
global proof/search mechanisms with polynomially checkable exact progress and no exponential hidden state

next_constructive_candidate.name: E8_NONHOMOMORPHIC_MULTILINEARIZATION_OR_CANCELLATION_CARRIER
next_constructive_candidate.target: Compute whether multilinearize(product_C c_C) is zero without materializing its 2^n coefficient/evaluation basis.
next_constructive_candidate.required_lemma: There exists a representation R(F) of size poly(|F|), constructible in poly(|F|), supporting exact clause incorporation plus an exact zero/nonzero decision for the Boolean multilinearization, with polynomial-time witness reconstruction.
next_constructive_candidate.why_this_is_not_yet_an_algorithm: The required lemma is currently unproved. Any implementation that expands the Boolean quotient basis, truth table, DNNF/OBDD state space, or all boundary assignments violates the polynomial bound.

open_access_audit.source: Huang, Improved complexity results on k-coloring P_t-free graphs, European Journal of Combinatorics 51 (2016)
open_access_audit.relevance: 4-COLORING is NP-complete on P7-free graphs; validates that the Huang source family is genuinely NP-hard rather than a hidden tractable graph subclass.

open_access_audit.source: Jiang and Cai, A Better Analysis For PPSZ For 3-SAT, arXiv:2607.10697
open_access_audit.relevance: Reports O*(1.307031578^n) randomized worst-case time for general 3-SAT; confirms that current exact-algorithm progress remains exponential rather than polynomial.

open_access_audit.source: Tovey, A simplified NP-complete satisfiability problem, Discrete Applied Mathematics 8 (1984)
open_access_audit.relevance: 3-SAT remains NP-complete when every variable occurs in at most four clauses; degree/sparsity alone cannot be the missing polynomial contraction.

open_access_audit.source: Bova, Capelli, Mengel, Slivovsky, A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas, arXiv:1411.1995
open_access_audit.relevance: Shows unconditional exponential DNNF size for a CNF family; generic exact knowledge compilation into DNNF cannot be assumed polynomial.

current_verdict.NEW_RESULT: A clean exact barrier eliminates fixed polynomial-dimensional multiplicative Boolean-quotient sketches from the E8 search space.
current_verdict.NEXT: Attack the non-homomorphic multilinearization/cancellation carrier; immediately falsify any candidate that hides exponential basis size, exponential integer bitlength, or exponential boundary states.
